raw_snippet: Exigent Technologies Aligns with Shield Technology Partners to Strengthen Long-Term Client Support and Innovation
value_text: announced as joining its group: Exigent Technologies (IT managed-service provider, USA)
note: DOUBTFUL ON STAKE: Exigent calls it a 'strategic partnership' and does not state the stake; it is listed on Shield's own-companies page and trade press says Shield holds controlling stakes in its MSPs.
